search_audit.outcome: Search results surfaced exact Commons leads and the Shuowen.cn entry. Directly opened the 了-seal.svg page and Xiaoxuetang rights notice. The ACC-s10990.svg page was available in search results but direct opening gave a cache miss. The Shuowen Seal Radical 526 page also gave a cache miss; its search result only showed category membership and did not verify file identity or rights. Direct attempts to open the original SVG assets were inaccessible in this web tool.

gaps: No ancient artifact image or image of an independently dated specimen was verified. The candidate is explicitly a modern redraw in Shuowen seal-script style and cannot adjudicate the competing crossed/entangled-legs and child-without-arms interpretations.
The direct original SVG URL is documented on Commons, but direct access to the asset failed in this browser tool; visual inspection was not performed here.

The ACC-s10990 page was surfaced in search results with identity and public-domain terms, but opening the exact page returned a cache miss. The Shuowen Seal Radical 526 page likewise could not be opened, so it is not proposed.
No Xiaoxuetang character-specific image URL was retrieved. The official CC0 notice alone does not identify a usable glyph candidate.
